description: This Java class provides enumeration utilities for scheduled email features within the Fineract project, including methods to convert email attachment formats and report date options into EnumOptionData objects.

classes.name: ScheduledEmailEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to convert email scheduling related enums into general-purpose EnumOptionData objects.

methods.name: emailAttachementFileFormat
methods.description: Converts a file format ID or string into an EnumOptionData representing the attachment file format.

methods.name: stretchyReportDateOption
methods.description: Converts a report date option enum into an EnumOptionData object.
